photo.caption: The Hawaiian-Emperor seamount chain
photo.description: The trail of underwater mountains created as the tectonic plate moved across the Hawaii hotspot over millions of years, known as the Hawaiian-Emperor seamount chain, or the Emperor Seamounts.

photo.caption: Reconstruction of eastern Gondwana showing position of orogenic belts
photo.description: Paleotectonic map of eastern Gondwana with the Pan-African and/or circum-Antarctic orogenic (“mobile”) belts highlighted by age differences (See Fitzsimons, 2000a, cited in Meert, 2003, follow source link below).
